systems.country_label: Electronic Civil Registration and Vital Statistics (E-CRVS) system; VitalReg platform
systems.platform: operated under a public-private partnership with Barnks-forte Technologies Ltd
systems.tiers: operational nationwide from 1 July 2026; 4,011 functional registration centres of the Commission across the 774 local government areas, to rise to about 8,000; 24-hour online access

note: A national commission's civil registration platform and its own registration centres: local government areas are where the centres sit; nothing on local government offices or their connection.
